Industrial Distillation Tower & Distillation Column

Product Introduction

The Industrial Distillation Tower, also known as a Distillation Column, is essential equipment for separating and purifying liquid mixtures based on differences in component volatility and boiling points. Through controlled heating, vaporization, condensation, and vapor-liquid contact, it enables effective separation and recovery of various chemical components.

TONGYANG specializes in manufacturing customized distillation towers and chemical process equipment for petroleum refining, petrochemical processing, chemical manufacturing, and solvent recovery applications. Our equipment can be manufactured according to customer specifications, operating conditions, and applicable international standards.

Working Principle

Distillation towers separate liquid mixtures through differences in component volatility. Inside the column, rising vapor contacts descending liquid through trays or packing materials, allowing repeated mass transfer and progressive separation of components.

Two common operating methods include:

  • Atmospheric Distillation: Operates at or near atmospheric pressure and is widely used in petroleum refining and chemical separation.

  • Vacuum Distillation: Operates under reduced pressure to lower boiling temperatures, making it suitable for high-boiling-point and heat-sensitive materials.
